svg.aria-label: 44 capsule shapes from one study file, each coloured by its surface heat flux
svg.text: 44 capsule shapes on one mesh topology, heat flux ratio at 6,722 nodes; one of each shape's 31 runs, the one nearest 10° incidence
1,364 runs in 66 MB. Each field is one block of runs × nodes; node k is the corresponding point on every shape.
